title: Print shop catalog, recorded by Helena with --me, tasks given to her by name

reference.speaker: Others
reference.text: Morning. Today we plan the spring catalog for the print shop.

reference.speaker: Me
reference.text: Right. The paper order is still open.

reference.speaker: Others
reference.text: Helena will call the paper supplier by Monday.

reference.speaker: Me
reference.text: Okay, that works for me. What about the cover?

reference.speaker: Others
reference.text: Victor will fix the cover photo by Thursday.

reference.speaker: Me
reference.text: Good, the old photo was too dark anyway.

reference.speaker: Others
reference.text: And Helena sends the price list to the designer.

reference.speaker: Me
reference.text: Sure, I have the latest prices here.

reference.speaker: Others
reference.text: We decided to print five hundred copies of the catalog.
